title: Work Board
imageAlt: Work board with example data: a row of pull requests waiting for your review above five columns, from To do to Ready to merge, with labels, reviewers, stacked pull requests and a private note
description: *Work Board* is a **personal board built on GitHub issues**. It runs with no server: you paste a fine-grained token and the page talks to GitHub straight from the browser.
The notes you write are **private and yours**. They live in a JSON file in a private repository you own, so the board follows you from laptop to phone and every change keeps a history.
Two devices can edit at once. The merge runs **record by record**, so nothing you wrote is overwritten, and a set of tests pins the decisions that are expensive to break.
